event_records.description: The Alder Court neighbors have discussed setting up a water table for the marathon on Sunday. Priya has bought cups. No setup has occurred yet.

priya.persona_brief:

Priya has already bought cups for the water table. She is one of the Alder Court neighbors who discussed the plan on the app. She wants the table to be set up before the runners pass.

resolution.question: The Riverton marathon starts Sunday at 07:00. Will the Alder Court neighbors, who have discussed it all month on the app, actually set up their planned water table before the first runners pass around 08:30?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the water table was actually set up at the corner of Alder Court (mile four) before the first runners pass around 08:30 on Sunday, 2026-10-11. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
